<!--
Known issue template. Use it for an entry under "Known issues" in the release
notes, or for the first comment of a pinned issue.
-->

### Short description of what goes wrong

- **Affects:** versions X.Y to X.Z; macOS versions, if it matters.
- **What happens:** what the user sees.
- **When:** the conditions that trigger it.
- **Workaround:** what to do until it is fixed, or "none".
- **Status:** being investigated / fix planned for X.Y / waiting for a fix in
  a third-party tool (link).
- **Issue:** link.
